Essendon, Moonee Valley

Administratively Essendon is Moonee Valley. Geographically it is western Melbourne. About 20,596 people live in Essendon. The rate in Essendon matches the rate across Moonee Valley and across the metro area generally.

Essendon clears the bar at roughly 40 searches a month, which is the only test applied to any suburb here. Around 70 a month in Essendon want gutters as well, and in Essendon doing both in one visit is the cheaper way to go about it.

No Essendon job is on the public record. That is a gap in what we can prove about Essendon rather than a gap in where we take the glass.

The extras

Where two quotes diverge

Most of the gap between two Essendon window quotes is not the glass. It is everything around the glass.

The five things to confirm

Tracks and sills. Flyscreens. Frames. Whether the inside is included. And anything above ground floor reach, which is a different cost base rather than a small increment.

None of those are unreasonable to charge for. Finding out on the day is the only part worth objecting to.

Coated glass

What is on the surface

  • Tell us what is on the glassTint film, a factory coating or self cleaning glass all change how an Essendon window gets cleaned.
  • Film scratchesAnd once it is scratched the only fix is replacing the film. It is the single most damageable thing on a window.
  • Lifted film edgesWater driven under one finishes the panel. Where film is already lifting we will say so and work around it.
  • Self cleaning glass dislikes detergentThe residue defeats the coating. Plain water does a better job on it than product does.

Commercial

Glass with hands on it

  • Frequency, not techniqueThe work on an Essendon shopfront is the same as on a house. The difference is that it needs doing every two to four weeks.
  • Which makes it cheaper per visitGlass that never leaves maintenance condition is quick. The expensive clean is always the one after a long gap.
  • Timing is the constraintBefore opening or after close. Being flexible about the day rather than the hour is what keeps the price down.
  • Signage and awnings tooUsually the dirtiest things on a frontage and almost never cleaned. Sign cleaning.
